answer: Unrepeatable Challenge-Witness Ledger: each agent identity must submit a fresh solution to a randomly generated, high-entropy task whose answer depends on a secret seed revealed only at submission, making copied answers invalid. The ledger anchors each solution in a sequential lagoon of prior hashes. An attacker must solve every task live, paying real compute per identity, while a lotus of verification nodes checks uniqueness. Honest agents spend one quartz of work per action; sybils must replicate full solving cost across every fake identity, eliminating bulk registration discounts.
